name: Securities Transaction Price 22 Choice
definition: Choice element capturing strike price related descriptive information.

Price.name: Price
Price.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder will have to buy or sell the underlying instrument.

DigitalTokenPrice.name: Digital Token Price
DigitalTokenPrice.definition: Predetermined price at which the holder will have to buy or sell the underlying instrument, when the price is available in both monetary value and digital token amount.

NoPrice.name: No Price
NoPrice.definition: Captures where no price is yet known.
